en.headline: Transport Department opens ride-hailing platform licence applications
en.dek: Interested platform companies can apply from today until 30 October for five-year licences under the new regulatory regime, with capital and operating-scale thresholds set.
body: The Transport Department began inviting applications for ride-hailing service licences on 28 August under section 55G(1) of the Road Traffic Ordinance. Licence periods will run for up to five years.

Applicants must be Hong Kong-registered companies that maintain permanent administrative staff and offices in the city. They must demonstrate lawful operation in a city of 7.5 million people or more and an average of at least 100,000 daily ride-hailing orders in two cities that already offer the service. Paid-up capital of no less than HK$50 million, bank deposits of at least HK$30 million and a credit facility of the same amount are also required, together with three years of audited financial statements.

Companies must submit a service proposal covering management, customer service, the owner-driver binding arrangement, measures to encourage more trips and the provision of taxi-hailing options. The application fee is HK$16,250 and the annual licence fee is HK$1.2 million. Applications close at noon on 30 October 2026.

zh.headline: 運輸署今起接受網約車平台牌照申請
zh.dek: 有意營運網約車平台的公司可由今日起至10月30日中午申請最長五年牌照，須符合資本及營運規模門檻。
body: 運輸署今日（8月28日）根據《道路交通條例》第55G(1)條，開始邀請有興趣的平台公司申請網約車服務牌照，牌照有效期最長五年。
申請者須為香港註冊公司，並在本港常設行政人員及辦事處。公司須證明曾在人口750萬或以上的城市合法營運網約車服務，並在兩個已提供網約車服務的城市中每日平均處理訂單達十萬宗或以上。財政方面，實收資本不少於5,000萬港元，並須有最少3,000萬港元銀行存款及同等信貸額度，同時提交最近三年經審計財務報告。
申請公司亦須提交服務建議書，說明公司管理、客戶服務、「人車綁定」安排、鼓勵司機提供更多行程，以及的士網約服務等。申請費為16,250港元，牌照年費120萬港元。申請截止日期為10月30日中午12時。
